critical_code_review_comments: CinematicHero implementation: only the active is mounted at a time (signature changes after 7s confirm rotation works). Spec said 'multiple elements exist' — current implementation uses a single with src swap, which is functionally equivalent and lighter on DOM. If main agent wants the literal multi-img preload pattern for smoother crossfade, render all 6 images stacked with opacity transitions instead of swapping src.

Footer uses 'PS IXL Building, 5th Flr, Room 511' (abbreviated) while ContactPage uses full 'PS IXL Building / 5th Floor, Room 511'. Both are acceptable per spec but consider unifying via OFFICE_ADDRESS_LINES export in lib/site.js to avoid drift.
console: React warning 'Invalid DOM property fetchpriority — Did you mean fetchPriority?' on home — pre-existing, not blocking, but a 5-character lowercase→camelCase fix in attribute will silence it.

console: harmless 401 noise from /api/auth/me when unauthenticated public visitor lands on home — expected by design (frontend probes auth status). Consider suppressing via try/catch silencing of 401 in the auth-context bootstrap so console stays clean for SEO bots / Lighthouse audits.

news_service.classify(): STATE_BY_CITY does not include all CITY_PATTERNS keys (e.g. no entry for cities outside India that aren't already a city-state) — current set covers required v5 cases but easy to extend later.
